name: math
description: Three math cases in one document: a displayed LaTeX equation (latexmath) block, an AsciiMath summation block, and an inline stem macro mid-sentence — each rendered by the MathJax shim to a self-contained SVG the engine embeds — plus a verbatim listing whose math-like markup must pass through untouched (source text, not an equation). asciidoctor-mathematical does not build on this platform, so the reference is the external Asciidoctor-PDF gem embedding the SAME shim-produced SVG assets (see reference-build/); the parity under test is therefore the wasm engine's SVG placement vs the reference gem's. MathJax emits glyph paths (no text layer), so parity is measured by a rasterized ink-map: same page count, math ink present, and the inked region's footprint + position within element-level tolerance (the tolerance absorbs the two engines' rasterizer antialiasing). The listing's literal markup is checked via labels: it survives into both text layers verbatim (never converted to a math SVG), which is exactly the verbatim-passthrough guarantee.
